def test_encode():
    # Empty string
    assert encode("") == ""

    # Uppercase input gets swapped to lowercase, vowels shifted +2
    assert encode("TEST") == "tgst"
    assert encode("YES") == "ygs"

    # Mixed case with vowels in both cases
    assert encode("Mudasir") == "mWDCSKR"
    assert encode("Goings") == "gQKNGS"

    # No vowels at all, only case swap
    assert encode("BCD") == "bcd"
    assert encode("bcD") == "BCd"

    # All vowels
    assert encode("aeiou") == "cgkwY"[0:0] + "CGKWY".lower()  # -> 'cgkwy'
    assert encode("AEIOU") == "cgkwy"

    # Vowels remain vowels after swapcase, shifted by 2 in ASCII
    assert encode("hello") == "GLLQ"  # swapcase -> HELLO -> H,G,L,L,Q
    assert encode("Python") == "pYTHQn"  # swapcase -> pYTHON -> p,Y,TH,Q,n

    # Digits and punctuation unaffected except case swap
    assert encode("a1b2") == "C1B2"

    # Repeated characters
    assert encode("aaa") == "CCC"
    assert encode("AAA") == "ccc"

def test_encode():
    # Canonical examples
    assert encode('test') == 'TGST'
    assert encode('This is a message') == 'tHKS KS C MGSSCGG'

    # Empty string
    assert encode('') == ''

    # Lowercase vowels get swapped to uppercase then shifted
    assert encode('aeiou') == 'CGKQW'

    # Uppercase vowels get swapped to lowercase then shifted
    assert encode('AEIOU') == 'cgkqw'

    # Mixed case consonants only
    assert encode('xyz') == 'XYZ'
    assert encode('aBcD') == 'CbCd'

    # Digits and punctuation unaffected
    assert encode('1234!@#') == '1234!@#'

    # Mixed letters, digits, spaces
    assert encode('hello world 123') == 'HGLLQ WQRLD 123'

    # Single vowel
    assert encode('a') == 'C'
    assert encode('A') == 'c'

    # Non-vowel letters swap case only
    assert encode('Python') == 'pYTHQn'
